verdict.rationale: The docs say agents can be managed headlessly through the ElevenLabs API and an Agents CLI, not just the dashboard, and agents can be created via the API. Agent testing can verify responses and tool usage before deployment. However, the evidence never shows these used non-interactively in a CI pipeline, and the CLI is only named, never described. Missing for 10: documented CI/CD integration (e.g. running agent tests in CI), CLI command/flag documentation, non-interactive auth (API keys/env vars) guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
